headline: Curation pipelines and tools for harmonizing omics metadata and variant interpretation
label: Curated Biomedical Knowledge Databases
summary: Manual curation and harmonization of large metadata and variant resources are being formalized into reusable software and data infrastructure.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the curation and structured integration of biomedical data into reusable resources. DeeDeeExperiment provides a Bioconductor S4 class extending SingleCellExperiment to store differential expression and functional analysis results alongside the underlying single-cell data. The curatedMetagenomicData and cBioPortal study applies manual curation and ontology-based harmonization to clinical metadata across 212,027 samples. VUSVista addresses variant curation directly, combining a semi-automated workflow with ACMG criteria, HPO phenotype data, and ClinVar update checks. What is new across these items is the packaging of curation and integration steps into explicit software or data structures. The items differ in domain, spanning transcriptomic analysis results, clinical metadata, and clinical genomics variant interpretation.
